jobs.description:
Zymofix is a dynamic and innovative scale-up dedicated to fostering sustainable and circular agriculture. We specialize in creating effective and economically viable microbial products designed to reduce farmers' reliance on agrochemicals while maintaining high productivity. Positioned at the forefront of sustainable agriculture, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions that empower farmers to grow healthy crops and improve yields without resorting to chemical fertilizers. Zymofix is planning the construction of an industrial-scale demonstration plant in 2027.
 

The Role
 

As our Office Assistant, you are the organizational heart of our office. You keep things running smoothly behind the scenes, make sure colleagues and visitors feel welcome and appreciated, and give our team a helping hand wherever it's needed.
 

The tasks listed below give you a taste of what the job involves, but they are only one part of the package. As a growing scale-up, our needs change quickly, and this role grows along with them. Whenever something needs to be organized, followed up or simply picked up, you're the person who jumps in.
 

Reception and general office support
 
 

• Be the first point of contact for visitors and suppliers, phone calls. 

• Handle incoming and outgoing mail and deliveries. 

• Order office supplies, keep track of stock levels and make sure we never run out of the essentials. 

• Order laptops for new employees.  

Recruitment support
 
 

• Support in recruitment by screening resumes 

• Schedule and organize interviews (coordinate agendas, invite candidates, book rooms and welcome candidates on site). 

• Keep candidate administration up to date and help ensure every candidate has a positive experience with Zymofix.  

Accounting support:
 
 

• Support in purchasing, shipping and logistics (sent packages via DHL, provide necessary documentation,...) 

• Follow-up on goods purchased by staff: tickets, reimbursements,...  

Work clothes and office supplies:
 
 

• Follow up on the work clothes and personal protective equipment for our team: track needs and sizes, order on time and manage stock. 

• Keep the office stocked with supplies and act as a contact point for suppliers.  

Employee engagement:
 
 

• Organize the end-of-year Christmas gifts for the team, from choosing and ordering to wrapping and distributing. 

You might be our perfect match if you meet the requirements below. But don't worry if you don't tick every box, we dare you to apply anyway. You never know if there’s another role at Zymofix that's a better fit for your skills.
 
 

• You are very well organized: you’re able to keep an overview, plan ahead and you don’t lose track of deadlines or details. 

• You are a true all-rounder who genuinely enjoys supporting others.  

• You switch quickly and easily between different tasks and keep your cool when priorities shift. 

• You are open to taking on new tasks and like to grow along with a fast-growing company. 

• You are hands-on, proactive and spot what needs to be done before anyone asks. 

• You are a people person with a warm, welcoming attitude, both towards colleagues and visitors. 

• You handle confidential information, such as candidate data, with discretion. 

• You communicate fluently in Dutch and English, both spoken and written. 

• You work comfortably with standard office tools.

• Do you thrive on challenging supplier pricing and uncovering cost-saving opportunities?
• Are you equally comfortable with data analysis and commercial negotiations?
• Looking for a dynamic role in an international environment where no two days are the same?
Then this opportunity might be exactly what you're looking for.

As a Technical Buyer, you will play a crucial role in driving procurement performance across long-term projects. Your primary focus will be identifying and realizing savings opportunities while building strong, strategic relationships with suppliers. You will challenge cost increases, perform market analyses, develop compelling business cases, and negotiate optimal commercial conditions.

Our client is an international supply chain specialist serving the automotive industry. The company manages the procurement and distribution of fastening solutions and technical components for leading manufacturers worldwide.

This position combines analytical problem-solving with stakeholder management and requires someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment where priorities and market conditions continuously evolve.

Key Responsibilities

• Analyze supplier price increase requests and assess their impact on procurement budgets.
• Conduct market research and benchmarking to validate pricing proposals and identify cost-saving opportunities.
• Develop and present fact-based business cases to support negotiations and purchasing decisions.
• Lead commercial discussions with suppliers and negotiate the best possible pricing and contractual conditions.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with existing suppliers.
• Organize and participate in supplier performance reviews and business meetings.
• Monitor market trends and proactively identify risks and opportunities within the supply chain.
• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to drive procurement efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives.
• Manage purchasing activities for strategic, long-term projects from analysis through implementation.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree, preferably in Business, Supply Chain, Economics, Engineering or a related field.
• 2 to 5 years of experience in purchasing, sourcing, procurement or a comparable commercial role.
• Proven experience in supplier negotiations and achieving measurable cost reductions.
• Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to interpret complex data and translate findings into actionable recommendations.
• Excellent communication and influencing skills.
• Commercially driven with the confidence to challenge suppliers and defend your position using facts and data.
• Experience within a technical, manufacturing or automotive-related environment is considered a strong advantage.
• Familiarity with procurement terminology, sourcing methodologies and supplier management processes.
• Fluency in English; knowledge of Dutch is an asset.

Production | Quality Control | Team Leadership | Rework | 5S | 3-Shift System

As a Production & Quality Team Leader, you will supervise a team of Operators and Inspectors. You organize the daily workload based on priorities, skills and available capacity, while ensuring that quality and production targets are achieved.

Your new companyYou will join an operational manufacturing environment where quality, safety and efficiency are key. As a Production & Quality Team Leader, you supervise Operators and Inspectors and ensure that production, inspection and rework activities are performed according to the required quality and safety standards.

Your new role
 Your responsibilities include:
• Supervising, coaching and motivating Operators and Inspectors
• Coordinating inspection, quality control and rework activities
• Performing first-off checks, line audits and spot checks
• Monitoring quality and ensuring non-conforming products are correctly identified
• Following up on production output, scrap and rework
• Training and supporting new team members
• Ensuring compliance with safety requirements, PPE and 5S standards
• Reporting and escalating quality, safety or operational issuesYou also ensure accurate shift reporting and maintain proper traceability of inspected and reworked products. 
Your profile
• Experience in a production, manufacturing or quality control environment
• Experience in supervising or coaching employees is a strong asset
• Basic knowledge of quality standards and inspection processes
• Hands-on, communicative and well organized
• Able to work under pressure and adapt to changing priorities
• Strong focus on quality, safety and operational efficiency
• Fluent in Dutch and English
• Willing to work in a 3-shift rotation
• Valid driver's license and access to a car

For our client, an international player within logistics with several branches worldwide and in Belgium, we are looking for a GL Accountant.

They offer various logistics solutions through their extensive network of offices, partners and warehouses.

They are looking to strengthen their team in Antwerp and are looking for a GL Accountant.

Jobomschrijving

For the position as GL Accountant at our client in the Antwerp region, we are looking for someone who is fascinated by the following range of tasks:

• You will process the complete accounting for the assigned companies and countries.
• You prepare the monthly and annual financial close of the assigned entities.
• You align accounting and operational processes.
• You will be responsible for the balance sheet analysis and monthly reconciliation of assigned entities.
• You prepare monthly, quarterly and year-end internal and group reports.
• You provide monitoring of costs, accruals and provisions in collaboration with the controlling team and local teams.
• You participate in the annual budgeting process.
• You foresee the closing of general ledger accounts and financial reporting.
• You participate in the annual external audit process if required.
• You will work closely with the Financial Controllers team in this process.
• You will always work on a country or entity based in Western Europe.

To fulfil this role of GL Accountant, you recognise yourself in the following profile:

• You hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Accounting.
• You have a first experience as a GL Accountant.
• You have a strong analytical mindset and attention to detail.
• You are fluent in English.
• You have a good knowledge of balance sheet analysis, monthly, quarterly, and yearly closing processes, IFRS, and reconciliations.
• SAP experience is advantageous.
• You are a team player who thrives in an international environment.

• Contract: 12-Month Initial Contract (Extension Likely)

• Language: English

Our client, a leading European Life Sciences & Healthcare organisation, is embarking on a large-scale IT, Cloud & Business Transformation Programme aimed at modernising core business applications, streamlining operational processes, and accelerating their cloud journey.

As the programme enters a critical delivery phase, they are looking for a highly hands-on Senior Business Analyst who can bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technology teams, driving requirements definition, process optimisation, and transformation initiatives across multiple workstreams.

This is not a documentation-only role. We are looking for someone who enjoys being Embedded within the business, challenging existing ways of working, facilitating workshops, and actively shaping future-state solutions.
Responsibilities

• Engage with business and technical stakeholders to understand current-state processes and system landscapes.

• Lead requirements gathering workshops across multiple departments.

• Analyse and document complex business processes, identifying inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.

• Develop current-state and future-state process MAPS.

• Define and document business, functional and non-functional requirements.

• Translate business requirements into actionable functional specifications.

• Work closely with solution architects, developers, project managers and integration teams throughout project delivery.

• Support cloud migration and application transformation initiatives.

• Conduct gap analyses between legacy systems and future-state solutions.

• Facilitate stakeholder alignment and decision-making workshops.

• Support testing activities including UAT planning, execution and defect management.

• Track requirements through implementation to ensure business objectives are achieved.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across business and technology functions.

• 7+ years' experience as a Business Analyst within complex enterprise environments.

• Proven experience working on large-scale IT transformation programmes.

• Strong background in business process analysis and optimisation.

• Experience gathering and managing requirements across multiple stakeholder groups.

• Demonstrated experience working on cloud transformation, digital transformation, ERP, CRM or systems integration projects.

• Ability to challenge stakeholders constructively and influence decisions.

• Strong workshop facilitation skills.

• Experience operating in Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery environments.

• Excellent communication skills with both business and technical audiences.

Preferred experience:

• Experience within Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Healthcare or Medical Devices industries.

• Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or GCP.

• Experience supporting application migration or modernisation programmes.

• Understanding of regulated environments and compliance requirements.

• Knowledge of data migration, integration projects or enterprise application landscapes.

Key skills:

• Business Analysis

• Requirements Engineering

• Process Mapping

• BPMN

• Stakeholder Management

• Workshop Facilitation

• Gap Analysis

• Systems Integration

• Cloud Transformation

• Agile Methodologies

• User Stories

• Functional Specifications

• UAT Management

• Change Management

jobs.occupation: Service Desk Analyst / IT Support Engineer (L1/L2)
jobs.description:
Our client is a well-established international organisation with a strong reputation for operational excellence and a people-focused culture. To strengthen its local IT presence in Belgium, our client is looking for a service-oriented IT professional who enjoys working in a collaborative and multicultural environment. The organisation promotes knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and professional development while offering employees the opportunity to work closely with both local and international teams.

As a Service Desk Analyst / IT Support Engineer (L1/L2), your responsibilities will include:

• Providing first and second-line IT support to end users.
• Managing incidents, service requests, and technical queries in line with established processes and service level agreements.
• Troubleshooting hardware, software, network, and Microsoft 365-related issues.
• Acting as the primary local IT point of contact for employees based in Belgium.
• Logging, tracking, documenting, and resolving tickets using the company's IT Service Management platform.
• Collaborating with international IT teams, vendors, and specialist support teams to resolve complex issues.
• Monitoring IT systems and escalating recurring or critical issues when required.
• Supporting IT projects, deployments, upgrades, and infrastructure changes.
• Managing employee onboarding and offboarding activities, including hardware preparation, account setup, and access management.
• Supporting meeting room technology, printers, audiovisual equipment, and local IT infrastructure.
• Creating and maintaining user documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational procedures.
• Identifying opportunities to improve processes, enhance service quality, and optimise the overall user experience.

The successful candidate will have:

• At least 2/3 years of experience in an IT Support, Service Desk, or End User Support role.
• Fluency in English & Dutch. French is a plus.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, Windows environments, end-user computing, networking fundamentals, and IT security best practices.
• Experience managing incidents, service requests, and change-related activities.
• Hands-on experience with Active Directory and Microsoft 365 user administration.
• Excellent troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to resolve technical issues independently.
• Strong customer service and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
• A structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach to work.
• The ability to prioritise tasks and manage multiple requests in a fast-paced environment.
ITIL, Microsoft, or other relevant certifications would be considered an advantage.On a personal level, you are recognised for your customer-centric mindset, team spirit, adaptability, and willingness to continuously learn and improve. You enjoy taking ownership, driving improvements, and delivering an outstanding support experience to end users.
